newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Tjiwi Kimia sees 1997 net up 30 percent.
newsitem.headline: Tjiwi Kimia sees 1997 net up 30 percent.

text.p: Indonesian paper firm PT Pabrik Kertas Tjiwi Kimia said on Wednesday it expected to post a net profit in 1997 which was around 30 percent higher than the previous year.

"We expect to post a net profit of around 30 percent this year because of the strong paper price and additional production capacity. Next year we expect to do even better," general manager for finance Gunawan Taslim told reporters after a shareholders meeting.
Taslim declined to give any further details.
Tjiwi Kimia posted a net profit of 145.09 billion rupiah in 1996 compared with 169.11 billion rupiah in the previous year.

The company's shareholders on Wednesday also approved a dividend payment of 60 rupiah per share for 1996 as well as a proposal to increase the firms authorised captial to 5 trillion rupiah from 2.3 trillion rupiah.
